entity.name: Demir Ajvazi
entity.description: Software developer from Serbia. I use the JAWS screen reader every day, and I build creative tools — video, audio and photo editing — that start with the keyboard and the screen reader, and work equally well with a mouse.

projects.name: Ultra Creative Suite
projects.description: A family of creative apps for Windows (video, audio and photo editing, captions, recording) designed keyboard- and screen-reader-first, and fully usable by sighted users. The video editor offers timeline editing, video layers, colour LUTs, export at the source frame rate, AI audio description that Gemini writes and a natural voice mixes into the video, and an AI music video creator — all reachable with JAWS and NVDA. Built in C# / WPF / .NET 8. Most creative software is made for the mouse first and made accessible later; this project starts from the other side.
